_comment: Traditional face-reading corpus. FOLKLORE, NOT SCIENCE (plan §4). Each entry reports what a named tradition CLAIMS about a facial feature value; it never asserts truth. `feature` + `value` must match core/features.py exactly. Every value of every feature has an entry, so a detected face always gets a claim for each aspect. Grow/edit by hand.

entries.claim: a long face belongs to the wood element -- read as thoughtful, methodical, and quietly idealistic, always building toward a plan
an oval face was read as balanced and diplomatic, at ease smoothing things over between people
a round face belongs to the water element -- read as sociable, adaptable, and warm, flowing easily with whoever it meets
brows set high above the eyes signal foresight and patience -- one who looks well ahead and keeps a cool distance before deciding
evenly-set brows mark steady judgment and an even temper, neither rushing nor stalling
brows sitting close to the eyes signal intensity and decisiveness -- a quick, instinctive spark to act
large, open eyes reflect an expressive, emotionally receptive, imaginative nature
moderately-sized eyes were read as balanced perception -- observant without being swept away
smaller eyes are read as focus and discernment, guarding a rich inner world
a broad, firm jaw signals determination, stamina, and willpower that sees things through
an even jaw was read as steady, adaptable resolve -- firm when it counts, flexible otherwise
a narrow, tapered jaw was read as sensitivity and a mind that prefers ideas and diplomacy to force
fuller lips signal warmth, generosity, and an expressive spirit ready to share feeling
medium lips were read as measured warmth -- an easy, even communicator
thinner lips were read as discretion, precision, and a reserve that chooses words carefully
